# M18-S5: comptime layout intrinsics eject to plain constants. The run
# fixture is the single source: its .out file is the expected output of
# the native build and of the ejected tree, which builds with plain go
# and stays gofmt-clean.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_layout.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_layout.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_layout.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/comptimelayout

go 1.27
